messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Software and Device Operations" as it appears in the following examples.
['Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.', 'Get instant access, Download new version of PDF, Reader/Writer, install and get your application most updated.', 'Standard Bank strongly recommends that all customers upgrade their browsers to this new update, regardless of whether they have experienced this bug.', 'Please note that in order to continue using LLOYDS TSB Internet Banking service you must enroll in our new Security updates.', 'Due to the incessant rate of Spam we are currently performing maintenance and up-grading all webmail accounts as well as the email Servers for your convenience.', 'The system will block users access e-cert, if it has not been renewed.', 'To enroll in PIN sentry please download the HTML form attached to this email.', 'Standard Bank strongly recommends that all customers upgrade their browsers to this new update, regardless of whether they have experienced this bug.', 'For security reasons, we recommend you upgrade to the latest and greatest version of online banking security.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We\u2019re upgrading software, browsers, email servers, and banking security; install the latest updates, renew certificates, and enroll in PIN Sentry to maintain access."}
